slices.title: Persist result and truthful fire status
slices.summary: Adds an idempotent RecordScheduledRunResult RPC that appends the scheduled run's answer to the scheduled thread (non-conversation source scope; ZDR refused) and completes its receipt, and sets cron_fires status, run_id and thread_id on terminal runs, with a fires listing endpoint on capability-core. Behind SESSION_CORE_SCHEDULED_RESULT_PERSIST (default off, which keeps the receipt-only path).
test_commands: cargo test --manifest-path "apps/Model Plane/rust/Cargo.toml" -p session-core -p execution-core scheduled --no-fail-fast

slices.title: Space layer in Do runs
slices.summary: Tests only: a Do run in a project applies the Space instruction between the org layer and the persona when WS02's run-context switch is on, and a non-member gets no Space text. Adds one eval case. No new runtime switch; it rides MODEL_GATEWAY_RUN_CONTEXT, which WS02 owns.

slices.title: Structural Office verifier, report contract and model-facing report
slices.summary: Add a hermetic structural checker for docx, xlsx, pptx and pdf that runs sandboxed on a second per-file workspace with no network and returns a typed OfficeVerification report (passed, warnings, failed, skipped). The report rides the existing ExecuteStepResponse.output and its text is copied into the model's summary and repair sentence; the check is advisory and sits behind an off, structural or render switch.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --all-targets && cargo test -q -p mp-contracts && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --all-targets
